name: Container
description: Container runtime boundary enforcement relies on kernel isolation primitives to maintain trust zone separation between workloads sharing a host kernel. Weaknesses in capability restriction, namespace isolation, seccomp/LSM profile enforcement, and ingress/egress filtering create vectors for trust boundary violations, zone traversal, and lateral movement. The attack surface spans privilege escalation through capability abuse, namespace escape, cross-zone credential bleed, and insufficient egress controls enabling trust propagation across segments.
